audit.why: Vel'Koz's range keeps Poppy's short-range engage kit off him early; level chart and 49.58% winRate agree the matchup is close-to-even, favoured Vel'Koz.
Level 2 Q-split, level 6 R punishing her low mobility, and first-item poke uptime spikes are already stated and grounded in the kit.
